title: 8 Things a Godly Man Only Says to the Brothers Who Have His Number
caption:
Every man has friends he laughs with and a couple he actually tells the truth to.

Not the group chat version. The real one. "I looked again last night." "I'm scared I'm turning into my father." "Check on me Thursday, I mean it." Lines you'd never type where everyone can see them. You only say them to the two or three guys who've earned the right to hear them.

If either of them goes under, the other one is close enough to notice. That's the whole point of having them.

Think of the truest man in your phone. Try saying the real line to him instead of the group chat one.
